title: Personalizing Change Management at Scale
gist: BCG argues transformations fail partly from a 'change distance' where executives underestimate employee needs, and that people-centered change management yields 15% higher TSR. Its AI Persona Engine segments workforces into behavioral personas in days rather than months, cited with a 31% developer productivity gain at a tech firm and 10 personas/100+ interventions in the Allegiant–Sun Country merger.

insights.claim: BCG research finds companies that make holistic, people-centered change management an integral part of a transformation outperform peers by 15% in total shareholder return.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Quality of change management in M&A/ERP programs is a measurable TSR differentiator worth diligencing.
insights.quote: companies that make holistic, people-centered change management an integral part of a transformation outperform their peers by 15% in total shareholder return
insights.locator: Your company is at the start

insights.claim: Change management programs have a poor record of success, so leadership optimism about transformations is often unrealistic.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Discount management guidance on transformation synergies and timelines.
insights.quote: an unrealistic level of optimism given change management programs’ poor record of success

insights.claim: BCG argues companies should segment employees into personas for change management in the same way they segment customers to drive product adoption.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Signals consulting/HR-tech demand shifting toward segmentation-based workforce tools.
insights.quote: Just as companies segment customers to get them to use a product, they should personalize their change management efforts according to distinct employee personas
insights.locator: Your company is at the start

insights.claim: A 'change distance' gap exists because executives systematically underestimate what employees need to navigate major changes and what makes them hesitant, with leaders more likely than employees to believe change will succeed.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Top-down transformation plans carry hidden execution risk from a leadership-employee perception gap.
insights.quote: executives systematically underestimate what employees actually need in order to navigate major organizational or operational changes

insights.claim: The executive-employee perception gap leads to enterprise-wide, one-size-fits-all change strategies that ignore how different stakeholder groups respond to change differently.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Monolithic rollouts (generic comms, untailored training) are a red flag for integration underperformance.
insights.quote: This perception gap produces a one-size-fits-all trap
insights.locator: This perception gap produces a one-size-fits-all

insights.claim: Generic communications, untailored training, and a lack of hypercare (periods of intensive, targeted post-implementation support) make good transformation outcomes even less likely.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Absence of hypercare budgets in integration plans is a leading indicator of adoption failure.
insights.locator: This perception gap produces a one-size-fits-all

insights.claim: Effective personas combine qualitative sentiment, behavioral indicators, role context, and industry dynamics into segments that are operationally and behaviorally distinct rather than merely demographic.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Workforce analytics value lies in behavioral, not demographic, segmentation.
insights.quote: segments that are operationally and behaviorally distinct, not just demographically different

insights.claim: Personas strengthen change strategy by prioritizing communications, training, and hypercare to the highest-need areas and by surfacing resistance, fears, and unmet needs before they derail program momentum.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Early resistance detection reduces transformation delay and synergy leakage.
insights.locator: Creating personas strengthens enterprise change strategies

insights.claim: BCG's AI-driven Persona Engine ingests internal workforce signals and external industry intelligence, layers on behavioral science and intervention tactics, and accelerates persona development from months to days.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: GenAI is being productized inside consulting to compress labor-intensive advisory work, a margin and pricing shift for the sector.
insights.quote: accelerating the process of persona development from months to days
insights.locator: This is where the Persona Engine

insights.claim: Individual one-on-one change management would be straightforward but no large company has the resources or time to do it, which is the gap AI is positioned to fill.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: AI enables mass-personalization of internal HR processes previously uneconomic at scale.
insights.quote: no large company has the resources and time to do so

insights.claim: The Persona Engine produces a heat map of the most influential actions per persona group and generates tailored change journeys showing where and how to intervene.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Illustrates the deliverable shape of AI-enabled consulting products.
insights.locator: The Persona Engine generates a set

insights.claim: In an AI transformation, the Persona Engine aggregates technology roadmaps, prioritized use cases, and company data to identify where change support is most needed across end users, power users, middle managers, IT admins, and data teams, flagging adoption barriers early.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Enterprise AI adoption bottlenecks are organizational, creating demand for change-enablement services alongside tech spend.
insights.locator: For example, a large company planning

insights.claim: A large technology organization's major GenAI rollout initially produced limited productivity gains, but after persona-based enablement embedded AI into developers' daily work it saw a 31% productivity improvement and shipped 27% more features that year.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Enterprise GenAI ROI depends heavily on adoption/enablement, not just tool deployment—supporting services and change spend around AI.
insights.quote: the company saw a 31% improvement in productivity and shipped 27% more features that year

insights.claim: Deploying GenAI tools alone does not guarantee productivity gains; the implication is that adoption design is the binding constraint on enterprise AI returns.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Be skeptical of AI capex payoff narratives that ignore workforce adoption.
insights.quote: rolled out a major GenAI implementation, but the results proved limited

insights.claim: The Allegiant Travel and Sun Country Airlines merger combines two leisure-focused airlines with 22 million annual customers, 175 cities, 650 routes, 195 aircraft, and a 9,300-strong workforce.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Scale metrics for the combined leisure airline relevant to ALGT/SNCY merger analysis.
insights.quote: a combined 22 million customers traveling annually between 175 cities along 650 routes in a total of 195 aircraft
insights.locator: The recent merger of Allegiant Travel

insights.claim: Allegiant used the Persona Engine to define ten industry-specific personas and over 100 tailored interventions across communications, training, and active engagement, linked to its broader integration roadmap.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Indicates Allegiant is investing in workforce integration to de-risk merger execution and labor disruption.
insights.quote: identify ten bespoke personas distinct to the industry that reflect the airlines’ 9,300-strong workforce
insights.locator: To augment an already robust integration

insights.claim: Each intervention was rated by its effect on a persona group, and plans for roles like people managers ran from pre-close actions through the full integration journey to support a smooth day one.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Pre-close workforce planning may reduce day-one operational hiccups in airline integrations.

themes.theme: Call to action: personalized change at scale

insights.claim: BCG predicts companies that adopt AI-accelerated, personalized change management will move faster, bring people along more effectively, and build lasting change.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Expect growing adoption of AI workforce-personalization tools in large transformations.
insights.quote: Companies that do will move faster, bring their people along more effectively, and build lasting, sustained change.

insights.claim: With AI-accelerated persona development, personalized change at enterprise scale is now achievable for every organization, making willingness rather than feasibility the constraint.
insights.speaker: https://www.bcg.com/about/people/experts/gertie-find-laerkholm
insights.so_what: Shifts the competitive question to management willingness—an execution-quality differentiator.
insights.quote: the question is no longer whether this approach is achievable but whether you’re willing to embrace it
